Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes, a damaged item is handled differently from a standard return.
For a standard return, items must be in pristine condition within 14 days and are subject to restocking fees. However, if your item arrives physically damaged upon delivery, you must report it within 48 hours of delivery so our team can assist you without treating it as post-delivery damage.
If you purchased optional Shipping Protection at checkout, damage in transit is covered, and our team will either send a replacement or issue a refund/store credit once reported with photos within 7 days of delivery.
